agent: K.9 Multi-tab + multi-user Echo fanout (read-only static)
scope: FoodKing Le Cayenne V1 — Pusher/Echo broadcast discipline across 6 concurrent surfaces (POS×2, KDS, OSS, Admin, Kiosk) on shared private-branch.{id} channel
methodology: Static analysis of broadcast wiring (Events / Outbox listeners / DispatchDomainEventsJob / channels.php) cross-referenced with every JS surface (KDS / OSS / POS / Kiosk / StockRuptureDashboard / PosOrdersTracker / KioskWaiting) and their subscribeEcho/unsubscribeEcho lifecycle. Sentinel tests inventoried and read in full.

channel_architecture.topology: Single channel per branch: private-branch.{branchId}. Per K.9 / C6 unified channel design — ALL surfaces subscribe to the SAME channel; cross-pollution is prevented by event-name filter inside each surface's handler array.

channels_defined.name: branch.{branchId}
auth_layers: 1. Kiosk-token discriminator: currentAccessToken()?->name === 'kiosk-token' → MUST equal own KioskMachine.branch_id (token-name check, IMMUNE to Sanctum '*' wildcard)
2. Admin / Tenant Admin role check: $user->hasRole('Admin') || $user->hasRole('Tenant Admin') → cross-branch allowed (NOT bare branch_id===0 — closes Guest-Echo-Bypass)

internal_only_NOT_broadcast.rationale: RefundCreated.php:14 explicit comment 'NOT broadcast (internal only)'. Bridges to OrderPaymentStatusChanged + OrderStatusChanged through downstream listeners + PaymentService::cashRefund (line 566 — explicit OrderStatusChanged::dispatch CANCELED). Surface fanout therefore travels via OrderStatusChanged, NOT directly.

events_inventory.ItemUpdated_path: ItemUpdated event fires CatalogChanged listener path (EventServiceProvider:249-252) → PersistCatalogChangedToOutbox + InvalidateKioskMenuCacheOnCatalogChange. JS surfaces receive CatalogChanged, not raw ItemUpdated.

K.9.1_OrderCreated_fanout.name: Customer at borne creates order → 3 surfaces react
discipline: Backend: OrderCreated fires PersistOrderCreatedToOutbox → DomainEvent row INSERTed (idempotency_key=sha1('order.created|'+id)) → DB::afterCommit hook dispatches DispatchDomainEventsJob → broadcast on ['private-branch.'.branch_id] as broadcast_as='OrderCreated'
POS PosComponent subscribeEcho() line 2642-2660: OrderCreated handler calls _notifyNewOrder + loadKioskCashOrders + loadActiveOrdersStats + loadReadyOrders (X2 sync)
POS PosOrdersTracker line 662: OrderCreated handler calls fetchOrders()
KDS line 1860: OrderCreated handler calls _debouncedRefresh()
OSS line 282-284: OrderCreated handler calls this.list()
Kiosk does NOT subscribe to OrderCreated (customer-facing, no need to react to other-customer orders) — by design
K.9.1_OrderCreated_fanout.delta_t_attestation: Per H-SYNC-001 polling fallback: ≤5s worst case. Per Q9-S1 measured 2026-05-21: ~1s wall-clock end-to-end when WS connected (vs prior 0-60s with polling-only). Heartbeat via Cache::put('ws:heartbeat',ts,120) at DispatchDomainEventsJob:129 attests broadcaster liveness to SyncOverviewController.
K.9.1_OrderCreated_fanout.branch_isolation: branchId baked into channel name 'private-branch.'+$order->branch_id (PersistOrderCreatedToOutbox:44) — cashier C in branch 2 NEVER receives the event because Pusher refuses to bind subscription to branch.1 (channels.php:61).

K.9.2_OrderStatusChanged_fanout.name: KDS bump → all surfaces transition
discipline: OrderStatusChanged fires after PUT /admin/order-status / KDS bump button. PersistOrderStatusChangedToOutbox writes DomainEvent with payload {order_id, old_status, new_status, branch_id}
POS PosOrdersTracker line 663-674: filters new_status===PREPARED → _markFresh(oid) then fetchOrders()
OSS line 265-279: filters new_status===PREPARED → pre-registers in _echoMarkedReady Set (de-dup vs subsequent list() refresh) then _markNewReady (sound + 10s flash, S-3 TV-optim)

KDS line 1855-1859: JS-side filter _statusChangeAffectsKds drops DELIVERED→REFUNDED / CANCELED→RETURNED noise — refreshes only when old OR new status ∈ {ACCEPT=4, PREPARING=7, PREPARED=8} (mirror KitchenReleaseRule)
K.9.2_OrderStatusChanged_fanout.admin_recent_orders_widget: POS Admin dashboard re-uses PosOrdersTracker component; OrderStatusChanged updates the tracker badge + ready-orders list.

K.9.3_ItemAvailabilityChanged_fanout.name: Admin toggles item → kiosk + POS + stock dashboard react
discipline: Backend: EventServiceProvider:201-209 fires BumpMenuSnapshotOnItemAvailabilityChanged + InvalidateKioskMenuCacheOnItemAvailabilityChanged + PersistCatalogChangedToOutbox + PersistItemAvailabilityChangedToOutbox
Kiosk KioskAppComponent line 547-552: re-fetches menu via _handleItemAvailabilityChanged (kiosk-side TTL 60s bypassed by BE cache flush)
POS PosComponent line 2690: subscribes ItemAvailabilityChanged → _onItemAvailabilityChanged (greys out tile in real time)
KDS line 1867: subscribes ItemAvailabilityChanged → _onItemAvailabilityChanged → dispatches into kdsInflight Vuex module (lazy-purged 10min TTL) so in-flight tickets flag the freshly 86'd item
StockRuptureDashboard line 478-479: subscribes ItemAvailabilityChanged → _debouncedReload()

KDS COMMENT (line 1862) accurate: KDS does react to 86 (in-flight marker), contradicts mission STEP K.9.3 'KDS doesn't need to react'. Order details from snapshot remain authoritative; the in-flight marker is an OVERLAY for chef UX
K.9.3_ItemAvailabilityChanged_fanout.mission_correction: K.9.3 mission says 'KDS doesn't need to react'. Code says KDS DOES subscribe + dispatches in-flight 86 marker. The mission spec is outdated post-CV1-KDS-INFLIGHT-OOS-MARKER-001.

K.9.4_CatalogChanged_and_ItemUpdated_fan.name: Admin renames item → ItemUpdated bridges to CatalogChanged
discipline: Backend: ItemUpdated wired in EventServiceProvider:249-252 to InvalidateKioskMenuCacheOnCatalogChange + PersistCatalogChangedToOutbox (mirrors ItemCreated/ItemDeleted via I.3 RISK-01 AMBER heal 2026-05-24)

ItemUpdated is NEVER broadcast as 'ItemUpdated' — it ONLY bridges to CatalogChanged broadcast. JS surfaces subscribe to CatalogChanged, not ItemUpdated. BROADCAST_MAP (eventContract.js:16-25) contains no ItemUpdated entry — consistent with backend design.
Kiosk handles CatalogChanged via _handleCatalogChanged + _handleCatalogChangeMidSession composable (useCatalogChangeNotifier — see ComposerProfileChanged handler line 561-565)
POS PosComponent line 2691: CatalogChanged handler → _onCatalogChanged

K.9.5_RefundCreated_fanout.name: Refund → POS / KDS / Loyalty clawback react
discipline_OK: EventServiceProvider:182-196 fires 4 listeners in strict order (per HEAL-PLAN-D.3 / RED-Z8 P2-2): PersistOrderPaymentStatusChangedOnRefundCreated → ReleaseStockOnRefundCreated → ReleaseAvailabilityOnRefundCreated → ClawbackLoyaltyPointsOnRefund (J2-HEAL-07 added 2026-05-24)

PaymentService::cashRefund:566 explicitly dispatches OrderStatusChanged::dispatch($order, $oldStatus, CANCELED) AFTER setting status=CANCELED. So FULL refund → OrderStatusChanged fires → POS/KDS/OSS all react via their existing OrderStatusChanged handlers
Loyalty clawback fires INSIDE the same RefundCreated listener cascade (try/catch isolated by J2-HEAL-07 so a clawback throw cannot halt cash-trail/stock/availability above)
gap_identified: RefundCreated.php:14 explicitly: 'NOT broadcast (internal only)'. Only OrderStatusChanged + OrderPaymentStatusChanged carry the refund signal to surfaces.

PersistOrderPaymentStatusChangedToOutbox.php:61 writes broadcast_as='OrderPaymentStatusChanged' BUT NO JS surface subscribes to OrderPaymentStatusChanged. BROADCAST_MAP (eventContract.js:16-25) does not list it. grep across resources/js/**/*.{js,vue} returns zero hits.

Practical impact: FULL refund (status→CANCELED) → surfaces react via OrderStatusChanged piggyback. PARTIAL refund (payment_status→PARTIAL_REFUNDED while order.status unchanged) → only OrderPaymentStatusChanged fires → SILENT on surfaces. KDS Historique drawer (filterable by status only) shows no badge.
K.9.5_RefundCreated_fanout.v1_classification: V1 Le Cayenne single-resto / fast-food = mostly cash full-refunds (NF525 cancel order). Partial refunds are V1.0.2 backlog (no UI today). Net: ACCEPT as V1.0.2 backlog finding — partial-refund silent fanout. Tracked: ADD OrderPaymentStatusChanged to BROADCAST_MAP + JS subscribers in POS/KDS Historique drawer when partial-refund UI lands.

K.9.6_channel_auth_race.name: 6 surfaces subscribe to private-branch.1 → channel auth gate
discipline: Auth flow: each Echo.private('branch.1') triggers POST /api/broadcasting/auth (bootstrap.js:343) carrying Bearer token from localStorage (vuex.kioskCart.kioskToken for kiosk, vuex.auth.authToken for staff/admin — selectSurfaceBearerToken helper)
Server-side routes/channels.php:41-62 evaluates 3 mutually exclusive branches:
- Kiosk: tokenName==='kiosk-token' → require KioskMachine.branch_id === branchId (BranchScope bypass via withoutGlobalScope)
- Admin/Tenant Admin: hasRole check → all branches OK
- Staff: user.branch_id === branchId
ALL 6 legitimate surfaces succeed (cashierA/cashierB/chef/OSS-public/admin/customer-at-borne) provided each role is rightly seeded
Race condition: Pusher subscribe ops are serial per connection — no race in the auth gate itself

K.9.7_Echo_subscription_leak_on_reload.name: Cashier reloads POS tab → no zombie subscriptions
discipline: Page reload destroys window.Echo entirely (Pusher socket closed by browser unload event) — Pusher server reaps stale connections after activity_timeout+pong_timeout = 30+5s = 35s max (bootstrap.js:341-342)
Within the SAME page session: every Vue surface calls unsubscribeEcho() ALWAYS BEFORE subscribeEcho() (defensive idempotency — AUDIT-P51-BUG2 / AUDIT-52-BUG2 / AUDIT-P1)

onEvents (eventContract.js:330-386) returns {unsubscribe} object that stopListening per binding + Echo.leave(channelName) — guaranteed by vitest spec echoMemoryLeak.spec.js (5 cases: object-shape, count-increment, count-decrement-to-zero, convenience-wrapper, skipped-bindings)
beforeUnmount calls _unsubscribeEcho on KDS:2368, OSS, POS:622, KioskApp:815 — symmetric to mounted/created subscribeEcho
K.9.7_Echo_subscription_leak_on_reload.sentinel_locked: tests/js/echoMemoryLeak.spec.js — 10 mount/unmount cycles never leave residual listener (contract clause 5)

K.9.8_multi_tab_same_user_different_surf.name: Cashier opens POS tab + KDS tab with same Sanctum token
discipline: Both tabs subscribe to private-branch.1 independently — Pusher allows multiple subscriptions per token (separate WS connections)
Backend broadcasts to channel — Pusher fans out to ALL subscribers regardless of who they are
Tab 1 POS handler updates POS state, Tab 2 KDS handler updates KDS state — no cross-pollution because the broadcastAs filter is applied INSIDE each handler array

Correlation dedupe: SAME correlation_id appears in BOTH tabs but each tab has its own sessionStorage (W3C spec: per-tab). Dedupe key is `${eventType}:branch:${branchId}:${correlationId}` (eventContract.js:260-268)
K.9.8_multi_tab_same_user_different_surf.info_note: Cross-tab dedupe is NOT shared (Audit G5/G6/G7 — accepted by design per eventContract.js:89-94 comment). Each tab acts on the same event once. POS/KDS handlers are idempotent (refresh-list patterns) so double-action is invisible. Toasts may fire in BOTH tabs simultaneously — by design, since both tabs are the same operator and they may have either tab focused. No action required.

K.9.9_three_cashiers_concurrent_branch_R.name: Cashier A (branch 1) + Cashier B (branch 1) + Cashier C (branch 2)
discipline: A and B both have user.branch_id === 1 → both authorized on private-branch.1 (channels.php:61)

C has user.branch_id === 2 → routes/channels.php returns FALSE for branchId=1 → Pusher refuses subscription with 403, JS receives pusher:subscription_error → wsService.handleSubscriptionError fires, sliding-window counter increments, no further attempts on branch.1
Backend broadcasts to private-branch.1 ONLY — branch 2 cashier physically cannot receive even if they spoofed channel auth (Pusher server enforces the channel-name → subscriber-set mapping)

BranchScope at API layer (CLAUDE.md §9 — 20 models) guarantees data exposure parity: even if branch 2 cashier somehow subscribed, the subsequent fetchOrders() would return branch-2 data only (User model BranchScope baseline-locked by BranchScopeCoverageSentinelTest)
K.9.9_three_cashiers_concurrent_branch_R.h1_evidence: Phase H.1 H1-multiuser-rbac-findings.json verified the same RBAC pattern at HTTP API layer empirically — cashC (branch 2) returns 403 / empty payload from branch-1-scoped endpoints. Echo channel auth pattern is the broadcast-layer mirror of the same discipline.

K.9.10_owner_admin_dashboard_observabili.name: Owner watches admin dashboard while cashier activity unfolds
discipline: Owner (hasRole('Admin')) passes the cross-branch clause in channels.php:56 — subscribes to ANY private-branch.{id} they request

Admin dashboard widgets typically subscribe to the owner's own branch (or fall back to polling if branchId<=0 which is the Admin branch_id=0 case — see KDS:1844, OSS:260, POS:2640 'if (branchId <= 0) return; // Admin: polling fallback')

PosOrdersTracker / PosComponent / KDS / OSS / StockRuptureDashboard fall back to polling for Admin user → polling intervals: POS 30s (kioskPollingInterval), KDS 5-60s, OSS list refresh on tick. Per heal B.3 2026-05-19 (config/broadcasting.php SoT note).
Per Q9-S1 measured: ~1s sync when WS active, ~30s worst when polling-only. Acceptable for owner observability widgets (not real-time-critical for owner POV).
K.9.10_owner_admin_dashboard_observabili.info_note: Admin (branch_id=0) by design relies on polling — single-resto Le Cayenne owner is also the staff/has direct access to branch-specific surfaces. V2 SaaS multi-tenant would warrant a presence channel for cross-branch live dashboard.

K.9.11_high_frequency_event_burst.name: 10 events in 1s → all 6 surfaces receive
discipline_present: KDS uses _debouncedRefresh() (line 1857-1861) → 10 events coalesce into ONE fetch within the debounce window
Correlation dedupe (eventContract.js:270-285): 2048 cap + 10-min TTL — burst of 10 distinct correlation_ids all retained, none dropped
axios error toast throttle (bootstrap.js:75 _BUCKET_MIN_GAP_MS=3000): even if surfaces fire 10 fetches and N return 429, only one toast per 3s bucket
discipline_missing: POS PosComponent (line 2642-2692): every OrderCreated handler calls loadKioskCashOrders + loadActiveOrdersStats + loadReadyOrders (3 XHR per event × 10 events = 30 XHR in 1s). NO debounce on this handler.
POS PosOrdersTracker (line 662, 672): fetchOrders() per event, no debounce
OSS (line 278, 283): this.list() per event, no debounce — could fire 10 list refreshes in 1s

Net: under a real 10/sec burst from multi-cashier + multi-kiosk activity, POS+OSS surfaces could storm the API with 40-60 XHR in 1s — caught by api rate-limit (429 → toast suppressed via 3s bucket), but real network spam
K.9.11_high_frequency_event_burst.v1_classification: INFO/P2 — acceptable for V1 single-resto where event rate is realistically <2/sec sustained (24+ tables × 1 status flip per 5 min = 0.08/sec peak). Wave-X soak test 50 orders/3 concurrency/7s = 21/sec INSTANTANEOUS — PASSED. Bursts mitigated by polling fallback already debouncing organic refreshes. V1.0.2 backlog: add _debouncedRefresh pattern to POS/OSS handlers (parity with KDS).

K.9.12_subscription_failure_silent_kiosk.name: Kiosk token broken admin subscription (J-ADV-6 PATH-1)
discipline: J2-HEAL-02 BlockKioskTokenFromAdminRoutes middleware (app/Http/Middleware/BlockKioskTokenFromAdminRoutes.php) intercepts ANY request hitting /api/admin/* with a Sanctum token carrying ONLY kiosk:order ability (no wildcard '*') → 403 + error='token_ability_insufficient'
Sentinel KioskTokenAdminBlockSentinelTest.php verifies BOTH: kiosk-only token → 403, wildcard token → not blocked (test_kiosk_only_token_is_blocked... + test_wildcard_admin_token_is_not_blocked...)

In Echo context: kiosk token subscribing to private-branch.1 succeeds ONLY if KioskMachine.branch_id === 1 (channels.php:46-50). Even if a kiosk token somehow received OrderCreated broadcasts via the channel, the handlers in KioskAppComponent do NOT subscribe to OrderCreated — kiosk only listens to ItemAvailabilityChanged + CatalogChanged + ComposerProfileChanged + CouponChanged (line 546-575). No data-leak path.
Defense Layer 2 documented (proposals/PROPOSAL_KIOSK_DEDICATED_USER_REFACTOR.md) — re-bind KioskMachine to dedicated kiosk_kayenne_borne_1 user with NO Spatie roles. Owner countersign pending.
K.9.12_subscription_failure_silent_kiosk.multi_tab_kiosk_attack_simulation: If attacker opens kiosk borne in dev-tools, copies kiosk-token from localStorage, opens new tab on /admin → BlockKioskTokenFromAdminRoutes denies 403. Echo subscription to private-branch.X with X!=ownBranch denied by channels.php:46-50. Self-contained defense.

findings.title: OrderPaymentStatusChanged broadcast has zero JS subscribers — partial refund fanout silent
findings.evidence: app/Listeners/PersistOrderPaymentStatusChangedToOutbox.php:61 writes DomainEvent.broadcast_as='OrderPaymentStatusChanged'. eventContract.js:16-25 BROADCAST_MAP contains no entry. grep -rnE 'OrderPaymentStatusChanged' resources/js → 0 hits.
findings.impact: Partial refund (payment_status→PARTIAL_REFUNDED while order.status unchanged) → no surface picks up the change in real time. POS Historique / KDS Historique drawer / OSS badge would only refresh on next polling tick. Full refund unaffected (piggybacks on OrderStatusChanged → CANCELED).
findings.v1_classification: V1.0.2 backlog. V1 Le Cayenne has no partial-refund UI today (cash-trail = full cancel). Add when partial-refund UI lands.
findings.fix_proposal: Add 'OrderPaymentStatusChanged: EVENT_TYPES.ORDER_PAYMENT_STATUS_CHANGED' to BROADCAST_MAP + new EVENT_TYPES.ORDER_PAYMENT_STATUS_CHANGED constant. Add handler to POS PosComponent + KDS Historique drawer subscribeEcho() arrays.

findings.title: POS + OSS Echo handlers lack debounce — burst can produce N×XHR storm
findings.evidence: PosComponent.vue:2642-2692 (3 XHR per event, no debounce); PosOrdersTracker.vue:662 (fetchOrders per event); PreparingAndReadyComponent.vue:278,283 (this.list() per event). Only KDS uses _debouncedRefresh (KitchenDisplaySystemComponent.vue:1857-1861).
findings.impact: Realistic V1 event rate (<2/sec sustained, 21/sec instantaneous Wave-X soak PASSED) does not surface this — but a multi-cashier + multi-kiosk burst could fire 30-60 XHR in 1s. Caught by API rate-limit + 3s axios toast bucket, but visible as network spam in dev-tools.
findings.v1_classification: V1.0.2 backlog. V1 ship-blocker false-positive — empirical Wave-X soak PASSED.
findings.fix_proposal: Mirror KDS pattern: introduce _debouncedRefresh() (250ms trailing) wrapping the XHR triplet. Or coalesce loadKioskCashOrders+loadActiveOrdersStats+loadReadyOrders into a single batched endpoint.

findings.title: Mission spec stale — K.9.3 says KDS doesn't react to ItemAvailabilityChanged, code says KDS DOES react
findings.evidence: Mission STEP K.9.3 'KDS doesn't need to react (already has order details from snapshot)' vs KitchenDisplaySystemComponent.vue:1867 'ItemAvailabilityChanged handler → _onItemAvailabilityChanged → dispatches into kdsInflight Vuex module' + comment CV1-KDS-INFLIGHT-OOS-MARKER-001.
findings.impact: None — code is correct, mission spec is outdated. KDS in-flight marker overlay is a desired UX feature (chef sees freshly 86'd item flag on tickets that include it).
findings.v1_classification: No action — update mission spec next iteration.

findings.title: Cross-tab correlation dedupe not shared (by design, documented)
findings.evidence: eventContract.js:89-94 explicit comment 'sessionStorage is per-tab (W3C spec); dedupe is NOT shared across browser tabs. Each tab maintains its own window. Cross-tab dedup would require BroadcastChannel + localStorage and is out of scope.'
findings.impact: Same operator with POS tab + KDS tab open will process the same event in BOTH tabs. Handlers are idempotent (refresh-list pattern). Toast may fire in both tabs simultaneously.
findings.v1_classification: No action — accepted by design (Audit G5/G6/G7). Cross-tab BroadcastChannel would be V2 SaaS multi-window dashboard scope.

verdict.echo_fanout_discipline: VERIFIED — single private-branch.{id} channel with per-surface event-name filter, broadcast wiring via Outbox+DomainEvent+DispatchDomainEventsJob, atomic claim under row lock prevents double broadcast, after-commit dispatch prevents broadcast-without-persist
verdict.branch_isolation: VERIFIED — 3 layers (channels.php auth + Pusher channel-scoped fanout + downstream BranchScope), kiosk-token isolation token-NAME check (immune to Sanctum '*' wildcard) + BlockKioskTokenFromAdminRoutes guard, both sentinel-locked
verdict.memory_leak_safety: VERIFIED — onEvents → {unsubscribe} contract sentinel-locked (echoMemoryLeak.spec.js 5 cases), unsubscribeEcho symmetric to subscribeEcho in all 7 Vue surfaces, defensive double-unsubscribe-before-subscribe idiom applied (AUDIT-P51-BUG2 pattern propagated)
verdict.subscription_failure_handling: VERIFIED — pusher:subscription_error → _refreshEchoAuth (token rotation pickup) + wsService 3-failures/60s → SESSION_INVALID promote → polling fallback always-on, 4-disconnects/30s storm breaker (decorrelated jitter reconnect)
verdict.recommendation: K.9 PASS for V1 Le Cayenne single-resto. K9-001 (partial-refund silent) + K9-002 (POS/OSS handler debounce) tracked as V1.0.2 backlog. No code change required for V1 cut.
